description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirement You have petitioned Mother Marrow (§5).

Requires a prior petition to Mother Marrow (§5) — once per day, auto-succeed a Medicine or Graft-crafting check.

Once per day, treat a Medicine check or a Graft-crafting check as a critical success if it would otherwise be a success, or a success if it would otherwise fail. You must declare this before rolling.

cinderfall.incomplete: The core reclassification (an otherwise-failed check upgraded to a success, an otherwise-successful one upgraded to a critical) is confirmed real and buildable via AdjustDegreeOfSuccess -- the earlier assumption that a failure could never become a real success was wrong; {"success": "to-critical-success", "failure": "to-success"} ships live in pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/rogue/level-10/sneak-adept.json and 5 other real cards. Two things still block a clean build, though: (1) the card applies to "a Medicine check or a Graft-crafting check" -- AdjustDegreeOfSuccess's selector field is a single string (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts:22), so Medicine needs its own rule and Crafting needs its own, and "Graft-crafting" specifically (not all Crafting checks) has no confirmed predicate to scope down to -- selector: "crafting" alone would widen this well past what the card states. (2) "Once per day... declare this before rolling" is a usage limiter with no AdjustDegreeOfSuccess field for it and no confirmed real precedent found for gating a passive (non-Activated) upgrade to once/day -- building it unconditionally would misrepresent this as available on every relevant check, not once per day.
